issues.failure_explanation: Under 'periodic' conditions the matrices are defined by zeroing their first and last rows instead of adding wrap-around entries. Then D^x is not skew-symmetric (D_{2,1}=-1/(2Δx) but D_{1,2}=0), and z^T D^x z = (z_{N-1}z_N - z_1 z_2)/(2Δx) ≠ 0. D^xx is not symmetric. D^+ is undefined in row N_x. issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Define genuinely periodic circulant stencils: D_{1,N}^x=-1/(2Δx), D_{N,1}^x=1/(2Δx), D_{1,N}^{xx}=D_{N,1}^{xx}=1/Δx^2, keep the diagonal -2/Δx^2, and set D_{N,1}^+=1/Δx.
issues.overall_effect: The summation-by-parts identities, the Fourier analysis behind the CFL lemma, and both stability proofs rest on matrices that do not have the claimed properties.
issues.title: Boundary rows of the stencil matrices zeroed, contradicting periodicity and summation by parts
issues.why_classification: A local, standard redefinition restores every identity and leaves all results and rates unchanged.
